questions.question: According to commercial cinematography standards, what is the standard 180-degree shutter rule when shooting at 24 frames per second (fps)?
options: Set shutter speed to 1/48 or 1/50 second to maintain natural motion blur
Shutter speed is irrelevant when shooting in Log
questions.explanation: The 180-degree shutter rule specifies shutter speed should be double the frame rate (1/50s at 24fps) to reproduce natural human motion cadence.

questions.question: In DaVinci Resolve color grading, which node stage should come before applying a creative look-LUT?
options: Primary balancing, exposure correction, and color space transform
questions.explanation: Primary color balance, exposure adjustments, and color space transforms must be normalized into a standard gamut before applying creative aesthetic LUTs.

questions.question: What is the difference between a J-cut and an L-cut in rhythmic video editing?
options: In a J-cut, the audio of the next scene precedes the visual; in an L-cut, the audio of the current scene continues under the next visual
J-cuts are for YouTube, L-cuts are for television
There is no difference; they are synonymous
questions.explanation: A J-cut leads with incoming audio before the video cut; an L-cut lets trailing audio linger while cutting to the following visual shot.

questions.question: What is the target integrated loudness standard for commercial web video on YouTube and Spotify?
questions.explanation: Standard web audio streaming targets -14 LUFS integrated loudness to prevent harsh digital clipping or automatic volume attenuation.

questions.question: When lighting a human subject with a 3-point setup, what is the function of the backlight (hair light)?
options: To separate the subject from the background by creating an edge rim on the hair and shoulders
To blind the actor for dramatic effect
questions.explanation: The hair light creates specular edge definition, physically separating the subject from the backdrop and enhancing spatial depth.
